stem.text: Four beams of the same length each have three forces acting on them.
Which beam has both zero resultant force and zero resultant torque acting?

A.alt: Beam with upward forces labelled 30 N and 50 N at its ends and a downward force labelled 90 N, with distances 50 cm and 30 cm.

B.alt: Beam with upward forces labelled 36 N and 70 N at its ends and a downward force labelled 106 N, with distances 50 cm and 30 cm.

C.alt: Beam with upward forces labelled 28 N and 35 N at its ends and a downward force labelled 63 N, with distances 50 cm and 30 cm.

D.alt: Beam with upward forces labelled 42 N and 70 N at its ends and a downward force labelled 112 N, with distances 50 cm and 30 cm.
